pages.text: Roasts beans one roast darker, burning furnace fuel. Beans go in the top, fuel below, and the roasted beans come out on the right.
Raw beans roast to $(item)Light$(), light to $(item)Medium$(), and medium to $(item)Dark$(). Dark is as dark as they go.

$(li)Roasting keeps the beans' $(l:caffeinecubed:basics/bean_quality)quality$(/l).$(li)Each bean takes 10 seconds.$(li)Fuel only burns while roasting: one coal roasts exactly 8 beans.$(li)Hoppers work like on a furnace.
